blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Three individuals aboard a hot air balloon that missed its scheduled landing here Monday night were confirmed safe in Quezon town early Tuesday morning, Nov. 24. The passengers were identified as Radin de Leon, 23, his cousin Crosby Salcedo, 25, both of Malaybalay City, and the balloon’s unidentified pilot. The trio had taken off from Barangay Can-ayan in Malaybalay City late Monday afternoon, November 23.
